info.title: ContextFetch
info.description: Web search and page contents for AI agents, returned as Markdown pruned to the passages relevant to the query. No key is needed for 25 requests per IP per UTC day; `POST /v1/keys/free` gives a free key with 2,500 credits; packs are one-time payments (https://contextfetch.dev/pricing). The Exa SDKs work with base URL `https://api.contextfetch.dev` and the Tavily SDKs with `https://api.contextfetch.dev/tavily`. Full reference with response examples: https://contextfetch.dev/llms-full.txt

402.description: Keyless daily limit reached or out of credits (`keyless_limit`, `insufficient_credits`). The body lists the credit packs with checkout links; the `X-Payment-URL` header has the default one.

post.description: Web search for AI agents. Each result has its title, URL and date and, when asked for in `contents`, the page as Markdown (`text`), `highlights` and `prunedContext`: only the passages relevant to the query, chosen by a cross-encoder. Exa-compatible request and response; `/search` takes the same body.

post.description: Runs up to 5 sub-queries (yours, or derived from `query`) at once, merges the pages by URL, ranks them against `query` with the cross-encoder and returns one evidence pack with highlights and pruned context. `depth: deep` adds sub-topics, the pages hub results link to, and a cited `report` (1 credit). No LLM.

post.description: A finished answer with [n] citations: one deep search of the live web, its passages as evidence, and an answer written from them by an LLM (gpt-oss-120b); when the sources lack it, a second search with new queries. `stream: true` sends the sources, then the answer as it is written (server-sent events). `depth: standard`: a short research agent (plans, reads pages in full, searches again for what is missing) for questions that need several facts. Research runs (`/v1/agent/runs`) are the long version.

post.description: Tell us a /v1/agent answer was wrong, outdated, incomplete or not supported by its sources (or good), with the right answer if you know it. Free, with a key. We keep only what you send and the day, never your key or IP, and future versions are tested against it.

post.description: An agent that researches in steps (Exa Agent's API): it searches, reads and takes cited notes until the task is done or the effort's budget is spent. Tables and lists are built row by row (list pages read in full, then sub-agents fill the empty cells); `input.data` rows are enriched, `input.exclusion` rows left out; with `outputSchema`, `output.structured` is validated JSON with `output.grounding` citations. Answers at once with the queued run: poll `GET /v1/agent/runs/{run_id}` or stream its events. `effort` medium (high and xhigh run as medium): flat price per run; failed or cancelled runs are refunded.

post.description: Bounded crawl from `url`: up to 5 hops and 500 pages, with path and domain filters; best-first when `query` (or `instructions`) says what to look for. Each page as Markdown. Over 50 pages (or `async`) it answers 202 with a job id for `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}`. Tavily /crawl-compatible at `/tavily/crawl`.
